title: Clinical Supervisor - OR - LCSW - Remote
description:
Thriveworks is currently seeking a Licensed Clinical Supervisor (LCSW) in Oregon.

**MUST live in OR, WA, ID, or UT and be licensed within the state of Oregon.**

About the Job
Thriveworks is a mental health care company founded by clinicians in 2008 and still led by them today. With 340+ locations and a nationwide hybrid care model, we serve over 175,000 clients annually through more than 1.7 million sessions, and we're growing. In addition to working directly with clients, we partner with health systems and primary care providers because we believe mental health is inseparable from physical health. As a clinician-led organization, we're built to support the people who do this work with the tools, community, and stability you need to build a career that lasts.

About the Role

Provision of clinical supervision to an assigned group of Resident Talk Therapists who provide diagnostic assessments, therapy, and counseling in an outpatient setting for a diverse caseload that can include adults, adolescents, children, couples, and families.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provision of supervision to a minimum of six (6) resident clinicians. Provision of weekly group supervision. Provision of individual supervision to each resident clinician for every 15 clinical hours. This would equate to a minimum of 7 hours/week for a supervisor, which varies depending on the Resident caseload size.

  • Consistently available to clients for a minimum of 15 sessions with 20 hours of availability weekly (no Supervision only)

  • Willingness to provide documentation oversight

  • Coaching on professional and clinical development of the resident clinician

  • Completion of weekly documentation as evidence of supervision sessions.

  • Completion of coaching documentation regarding any disciplinary or performance concerns.

  • Collaboration with the Regional Clinical Director regarding any performance issues.

Qualifications

  • Ability to be appropriately assertive in coaching residents on professional and clinical goals

  • Active license in good standing and residing within the state in which supervision will be provided

  • Meets state regulatory requirements for the provision of supervision to include maintaining required license and certifications necessary to provide supervision to license-in-process individuals, those already approved by their state board for supervision preferred

  • Active credentialing with the required Incident-to panels within the state where supervision will be provided

Supervisor Requirements for LCSW in OR

LCSW

  • Must be an Oregon-licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) in good standing.

  • Must have held an active LCSW license for at least 2 years before beginning supervision.

  • Must have at least 15 hours of training or continuing education in supervision methods prior to supervising.

  • Must complete 6 hours of supervision-specific CE every 5 years to remain eligible to supervise.

  • Must have passed the Oregon Laws and Rules Exam within the previous 5 years.

  • Must be competent in the clinical areas and populations the CSWA will serve.

  • Must not have a dual or conflicting relationship with the CSWA (no family, romantic, financial, or therapeutic relationships).

  • May supervise only the number of CSWAs they can responsibly oversee (no fixed numeric cap, but workload must allow adequate supervision).

  • Must be able to directly observe, review, and evaluate the CSWA’s work.

Compensation for clinical caseload and Supervision

  • For Clinical Caseload: Clinician will receive Fee For Service rates with bonus potential (ex. 90837 could be $55.85 to $58.64 depending on caseload)

  • For Supervision: Provider will be compensated at a rate of fifty-five dollars and seventy-three cents ($55.73) per Group Supervision session and seventy-two dollars and forty-four ($72.44) per Individual Supervision session. In the event that the 90837-session code compensation is greater than the individual supervision rate, the 90837 rate (vs code) will be used. Provider will receive a code to document their supervision hours, and will be required to complete recording documentation of such supervision.

Benefits

  • As a W2 employee, you'll be eligible to receive:

  • Guaranteed bi-weekly pay for completed sessions

  • 401(k) with employer matching

  • Paid time off

  • CEU reimbursement and free in-house training

Our Community
Being a clinician can feel isolating, especially in a telehealth world. We're built to make sure it doesn't. You'll have access to live clinical support, monthly case consultations, and a vibrant online and in-person community of more than 2,700 licensed providers. All clinical leadership is promoted from within, so the people supporting you have been exactly where you are.

Ready to Join Us?
Apply today to become part of a team that’s changing mental health care for clients and clinicians alike.

Interested in joining Team Thriveworks? We're thrilled to meet you!

With Job scams becoming more and more frequent, here's how to know you're speaking with a real member of our team:

  • Our recruiters and other team members will only email you from thriveworks@myworkday.com or an @thriveworks.com email address.

  • Our recruiters and other team members may also contact you via text or phone to schedule an interview.

  • A google meets interview invitation will be sent via email and will only come from an @thriveworks.com email address.

  • Our interviews will take place over Google Meet (not Microsoft Teams, Zoom, or any other platform).

  • We will never ask you to purchase or send us equipment.

If you see a scam related to Thriveworks, please report it to infosec@thriveworks.com. You can contact employment@thriveworks.com with any questions or concerns.

Thriveworks is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Our people are our most valuable assets. We embrace and encourage differences in age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, national origin, physical and mental ability, race, religion, sexual orientation, veteran status, and other characteristics that make our employees unique. We encourage and welcome diverse candidates to apply for any position you are qualified for to bring your unique perspective to our team.

By clicking Apply, you acknowledge that Thriveworks may contact you regarding your application.

title: Director, Shopify Engineering
description:
About Ritual

Ritual is a personal health brand that is raising the bar for daily wellness. Known for our best-selling, clinically backed prenatal, we create science-backed supplements with transparency at their core. We believe women deserve products they can trust, backed by real evidence—not just promises.

We started by reinventing the multivitamin with the first visible supply chain of its kind. Today, we’re expanding into new categories with the same high standards that built our reputation. Hundreds of thousands trust Ritual, and we’re growing fast.

Our team of 120+ scientists, creatives, and skeptics is raising the bar for women’s health. We’re venture-backed, based in sunny Los Angeles, and always looking for people ready to challenge the industry—and do the best work of their careers.

About the role

We're hiring a Director of Engineering to own the Shopify platform that runs ritual.com. This is bigger than the storefront: Shopify is the commercial operating system of our business, and this role owns it end to end—catalog and store configuration, the app stack, subscription commerce, and the integrations that connect the store to fulfillment, operations, finance, and marketing.

You'll lead our in-house engineering and QA team, own the technical roadmap for the platform in partnership with product, and represent engineering with senior stakeholders across the company. Critically, this role sits at the intersection of every team that plugs into the Shopify platform: growth and retention marketing (pixels, conversion tracking, catalog syncing, lifecycle and CRM integrations), customer support (helpdesk and customer data tooling), supply chain and logistics (fulfillment, order and inventory flows), and accounting (revenue recognition and finance data). Each of these teams depends on the platform working for them—you'll be their technical leader, translating their needs into sound integrations and keeping the whole system coherent as it grows.

This is a platform-owner role with a leadership mandate. Our engineering team already carries strong Liquid theme development skills—your job is to direct that work and hold the quality bar, while personally owning the back-end and administrative depth of the platform: how the catalog is modeled, how subscriptions are configured, how orders flow to fulfillment, and how revenue data reaches finance. You won't be heads-down on feature work day to day, but you'll review PRs, and you can run the codebase, debug a production issue, ship a quick fix, or delegate with precision. We're an AI-forward engineering team—AI development tools like Cursor and Linear are central to how we plan, build, and ship—and we're looking for a leader who works this way natively and raises the bar for how the whole team leverages them.

What you'll do

  • Own the Shopify platform end to end, including catalog setup and product data architecture, store settings, markets and checkout configuration, and overall store health. Establish clear, scalable platform standards and help the broader team understand how and why the Shopify instance is configured.
  • Lead subscription commerce configuration through Recharge, overseeing plans and pricing, discount logic, customer portal experiences, and the connections between subscriptions, promotions, and international markets.
  • Build, maintain, and evolve integrations connecting Shopify with critical business systems, including supply chain and logistics platforms, fulfillment, order and inventory synchronization, accounting and revenue recognition workflows, webhooks, APIs, and custom applications.
  • Manage and continuously improve the Shopify app ecosystem, evaluating third-party solutions across functionality, performance, security, privacy, and cost. Partner with stakeholders to make thoughtful build-vs.-buy decisions and simplify the technology stack when appropriate.
  • Guide Shopify theme development by partnering with an experienced engineering team with strong Liquid expertise. Collaborate with digital product management and web design to bring new features and experiences to life, while contributing to code reviews and fostering a high standard for performance, accessibility, maintainability, and polish.
  • Shape the storefront as a flexible content platform, owning metaobject and metafield data models, the CMS experience for content editors (including the blog), and a reusable library of sections and components that empowers non-engineering teams to create and update pages efficiently.
  • Partner closely with growth and retention marketing as a technical leader, overseeing the implementation and health of marketing pixels and conversion tracking, product catalog synchronization with advertising platforms, lifecycle and CRM integrations, and the data flows that support them. Help teams identify and execute effective technical solutions that support growth and retention goals.
  • Connect teams across the business through the platform, partnering with customer support, CRM, supply chain and logistics, accounting, and other stakeholders who rely on Shopify and its surrounding systems. Help ensure customer, order, subscription, and financial data flows reliably to the teams that need it, while representing cross-functional needs in engineering planning and roadmap discussions.
  • Champion web accessibility for ritual.com, helping maintain the storefront in alignment with WCAG 2.1 AA standards. Embed accessibility into design reviews and definitions of done, and coordinate the annual manual accessibility audit with an external partner—from planning and triage through remediation and follow-through in the sprint cycle.
  • Help lead an AI-native development practice, using modern AI development tools such as Cursor and Linear to support thoughtful, efficient delivery. Establish team practices for using AI-assisted development responsibly, including standards for code quality, review, testing, security, and safe deployment.
  • Facilitate the team's sprint cycles from planning through delivery, helping groom and scope work, manage capacity, clarify priorities, and foster accountability across engineering and cross-functional partners contributing to the roadmap. Create the conditions for teams to deliver high-quality work predictably and sustainably.
  • Lead, hire, and develop the engineering and QA organization, supporting an in-house team of front-end engineers and a QA function led by a Senior QA Manager. Foster a collaborative, inclusive team culture and take shared ownership of quality and delivery across the full lifecycle, from planning and development through testing and release.
  • Build and manage strong vendor and partner relationships across the platform ecosystem, including app providers, agencies, and audit partners. Oversee budgets and contracts, set clear expectations, and create productive partnerships focused on measurable outcomes and long-term value.

Who you are

  • Clear Communicator: You express ideas clearly and thoughtfully—whether in writing, speaking, or storytelling. You tailor messages to your audience and make complex concepts easy to understand.
  • Empowered Collaborator: You work across teams with trust and respect. You challenge ideas constructively, co-create solutions, and move projects forward through collective effort.
  • Curious Thinker: You're naturally inquisitive and always eager to learn more. You ask questions, explore new ideas, and seek to understand the "why."
  • Self-Starter: You take initiative and move work forward independently. You bring fresh thinking that aligns with the team's goals.
  • Proactive: You anticipate needs, take ownership, and ask for support when needed. You keep momentum even without constant direction.
  • Systems Thinker: You recognize patterns, anticipate downstream impact, and build for scalability.
  • Detail-Oriented: You care about the details—because you know they add up to better, more trustworthy outcomes.
  • Resourceful (Scrappy): You figure things out with limited resources. You take initiative and find creative paths forward.
  • Technical Acumen: You bring deep engineering knowledge and apply it to real-world challenges.
  • Operational Excellence: You build and manage processes that make things run smoothly, reliably, and at scale.

What you'll need

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years of deep Shopify platform experience spanning administration and development: catalog and product data architecture, store and checkout configuration, markets, and app stack management for a high-volume brand.
  • Proven back-end/platform ownership: fluency with the Shopify Admin and Storefront APIs, webhooks, and app extensions, and hands-on experience building and maintaining custom Shopify apps and integrations that stay reliable over time.
  • Experience integrating Shopify with operational and financial systems.
  • Strong Liquid theme development fluency.
  • Hands-on experience supporting growth and retention marketing as a technical resource. You're comfortable leading these conversations, not just executing tickets.
  • Comfort operating as the technical hub for many non-technical teams at once—marketing, customer support, supply chain, accounting—translating between business goals and technical constraints, and managing competing integration needs without losing platform coherence.
  • 5+ years of engineering management experience—you know how to hire, set expectations, review work, develop engineers, and hold a quality bar across a team, and you've owned delivery outcomes at the team level, not just the ticket level.
  • Strong agile fundamentals: you've run sprint cycles, groomed backlogs, scoped and estimated tickets, and managed delivery accountability across a team and its stakeholders.

Nice to have:

  • Experience managing external contractors or agencies alongside an in-house team, including scoping their work, reviewing deliverables, and holding an outside partner to the same quality bar.

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification listed above. We're committed to building a diverse team and recognize that skills can be developed in many different ways.

Compensation

  • Pay Range: $183K – $220K
  • Your base salary is one part of your total compensation package. The salary range represents the entire compensation range for this position. Exact compensation will depend on a number of factors, which may include the successful candidate's skills, level, years of experience, technical expertise, and other qualifications. Not all candidates will be eligible for the upper end of the salary range. This role is also eligible for equity + generous benefits + 401k + unlimited PTO etc — see our list of perks/benefits below.

What We Offer

Health & Wellness

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
  • Healthcare & Dependent Care FSA
  • Mental health support via Wellness Coach and Calm Health
  • Pet insurance discount
  • 10 Wellness Days per Year (Final Friday of every month)
  • Free Ritual subscription during your tenure
  • Annual Wellness Stipend
  • Monthly wellness activities

Financial & Career Support

  • 401(k) Match (up to 4%)
  • Equity participation through stock options
  • Monthly Technology Stipend
  • New Hire Work From Home Stipend

Family & Flexibility

  • 5 months of gender-neutral parental leave for eligible team members
  • Flex Time for birthing parents
  • Family Planning via Maven Clinic
  • Monthly Childcare Allowance

Time Off

  • Unlimited PTO (with a 10-day minimum to recharge)
  • 11 Paid Company Holidays
  • Additional company time off for holidays that fall around a weekend
  • Winter Break (Christmas - New Years)
  • Holiday Diversity Policy
  • 2 Days to volunteer (Days of Action)
  • Focus Fridays for self-development and deep work

title: Senior Product Manager, Commercial Business
description:
About Omnidian

Omnidian, Inc. is a fast-growing Series C tech-enabled service company revolutionizing performance assurance for the distributed solar and energy storage industries. Omnidian is building a more sustainable future for the planet through our passionate teams, our innovative technology, and by creating an amazing customer experience. We are a certified B Corp, headquartered in Seattle, WA

The Job

As the interim Senior Product Manager for our Commercial business line, you will be the primary product leader responsible for scaling our footprint in the Commercial & Industrial solar and energy storage market. Your primary focus will be on our Battery Energy Storage products and Small Commercial segment. Reporting to the Director of Business Product, you will lead problem identification, business case, and concept development for Commercial products. You will also be responsible for Monthly Business Reviews tracking the status and progress of Commercial Business Line health.

This is a short-term but high-impact role that requires a balance of strategic vision, technical depth, and a relentless focus on solving core customer problems. We are looking for a product leader who thinks in systems and scale rather than just features.

This position will last up to four months while our current Product Manager is on leave.

What You'll Do

    At Omnidian we believe in trust and autonomy. How you create an impact is ultimately up to you. Here is an outline of some of the things you’ll be doing:

  • Commercial Product Management: Own the product roadmap and execution for our TPO business line, ensuring our technology + service offering provides maximum value to TPO providers and financing partners.

  • Battery Energy Storage Technical Asset Management: Drive development of sophisticated BESS monitoring & servicing capabilities

  • Adjacent Market Discovery: Identify and evaluate opportunities in adjacent commercial & industrial energy markets to drive long-term growth and platform stickiness.

  • Problem-Centric Leadership: Apply deep product thinking to identify core business and partner friction points. Design solutions that balance immediate urgency with long-term scalability, focusing on the underlying problem rather than micromanaging the solution.

  • Ecosystem Integration: Understand building owners, installers, and capital markets needs as they are all critical stakeholders who will help us to drive overall success.

  • Pricing Strategy: Work with Finance & Revenue Operations to develop and implement sophisticated pricing models and financial structures to optimize market share and margin within the C&I sector.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Engineering, Go-to-Market, and Operations to ensure product alignment and successful execution.

  • Monthly Business Review: General manage the Commercial business line and lead the Commercial Monthly Business Review (MBR), synthesizing P&L performance and client-facing challenges into actionable insights while ensuring leadership alignment on long-term strategy and roadmap execution.

Who You Are

  • First Principles Thinking: You don't just accept "how things are done." You dig into the core problems and build solutions from the ground up for scale.

  • Strategic Urgency: You move fast because the market demands it, but you build with the structural integrity needed for long-term reliability and platform growth.

  • Ownership Mindset: You take full accountability for your product area, from high-level strategy to the granular details of execution.

  • Collaborative Influencer: Ability to lead through influence, building strong bridges between technical teams and commercial partners.

  • Effective Communicator: You can translate complex technical or financial concepts into clear, actionable narratives for senior leadership and external partners.

  • Product Visionary: You can look beyond the current roadmap to see where the commercial energy market is heading and position us to lead.

Experience You’ll Need

  • 5-8+ years of product management experience, specifically within a high-growth technology or renewable energy environment.

  • Deep expertise in the commercial solar and/or energy storage industry.

  • Direct experience in product pricing strategy and revenue management, with the ability to build and iterate on complex financial models.

  • Demonstrated track record of taking products from concept to scale, particularly in B2B or partner-led environments.

  • Strong analytical skills with experience using data to drive product decisions and measure success in complex ecosystems.

Experience That’s a Plus

  • Experience working directly with Capital market asset managers, Corporate owners and other distributed energy resource financing & ownership entities

  • Familiarity with the broader distributed energy resource landscape, including solar PV, battery energy storage, electric vehicle charging,

  • Track record of launching or scaling technology-enabled services products in a regulated or complex industry.

  • AI-native development and experience prototyping and building AI agents with tools like Claude Cowork

  • Advanced degree (MBA or technical MS)

Logistics

  • We plan to have this role start as soon as possible. It will conclude around December 4

  • We are unable to provide sponsorship for this role, now or in the future

  • This is a remote role. If you are in the Seattle area, though, we offer a vibrant office space in the historic and beautiful Smith Tower, in the heart of Pioneer Square

  • While this is a temporary position, we are a fast growing company and often rehire contractors into full-time positions as opportunities arise

Work-Life & Culture

  • We are a passionate, mission driven team that believes in collaboration, mutual respect and trust. For examples, come Discover our Story!

Privacy

California-based candidates: To understand more about the data we collect and process as part of your application, please view our California Job Candidate Privacy Policy. https://www.omnidian.com/privacy-policy-ca-candidates/

Diversity and Inclusion

We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background will lead to a better environment for our employees and a better product for our customers. We are committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We value diversity and inclusion and are committed to ensuring our hiring and retention practices, as well as our office culture, reflects this value.
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

We hire without consideration to age, ancestry, citizenship, disability, gender expression, gender identity, marital status, national origin, political activity or affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law.
We invite you to be part of our mission to create a workplace that is inclusive and welcoming to all.

title: In-Home Physician Full Time - Pittsburg, KS
description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Full Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

Full-time employees qualify for our comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Health, dental and vision insurance

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineering, Principal
description:
At AIA we’ve started an exciting movement to create a healthier, more sustainable future for everyone.

As pioneering innovators for over 100 years, we’re now transforming our organisation to be faster, simpler and more connected. Because we want to be even better equipped to develop digital solutions and experiences that help more people live Healthier, Longer, Better Lives.

To get there, we need people with tech/digital/analytics expertise and passion to help develop positive, sustainable change through digitally enhanced experiences that will impact the lives of millions of people and create a healthier future for everyone.

If you believe in developing a better tomorrow, read on.

About the Role

To deliver a secure, compliant, automated, resilient, and cost-efficient Azure cloud platform, supported by strong governance, enhanced observability and AIOps capabilities, and clear architecture and engineering leadership.

• Build and maintain secure, enterprise-grade Azure environments that meet regulatory and compliance requirements.
• Drive automation and modernization through Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and modern cloud engineering practices.
• Ensure platform resilience through high availability, reliability, scalability, and disaster recovery capabilities.
• Establish and enforce governance, risk, and compliance controls, including policies, guardrails, tagging standards, and security baselines.
• Enhance operational effectiveness through observability, AIOps, cost optimization, and technical leadership.

Roles and Responsibilities:

Cloud Infrastructure Engineering

  • Design, build, and maintain enterprise-grade Azure cloud environments that are secure, scalable, and compliant with regulatory requirements.

  • Develop and implement infrastructure automation solutions using Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform.

  • Ensure high availability, reliability, scalability, and disaster recovery readiness across cloud platforms.

  • Lead cloud modernization and platform transformation initiatives.

  • Drive cloud cost optimization initiatives and support engineering teams in understanding and managing cloud cost drivers.

Governance, Risk & Compliance

  • Operate within enterprise governance frameworks and ensure compliance with applicable industry standards and regulations.

  • Enforce cloud governance controls, including resource tagging, cost management, security baselines, and policy compliance.

  • Collaborate with risk, audit, and compliance teams to meet internal and external regulatory requirements.

  • Define and implement cloud guardrails, Azure Policies, and governance blueprints.

Observability & AIOps Integration

  • Collaborate with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and AIOps teams to strengthen end-to-end observability across cloud infrastructure.

  • Integrate AIOps capabilities to enable proactive incident detection, root cause analysis, and automated remediation.

  • Develop and maintain SLIs, SLOs, dashboards, and alerting mechanisms to ensure optimal platform performance and reliability.

Architecture & Engineering Alignment

  • Partner closely with Enterprise Architects to ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards, principles, and roadmaps.

  • Contribute to architecture reviews, solution approvals, and technology selection decisions.

  • Translate business and architectural requirements into scalable, secure, and sustainable infrastructure solutions.

Innovation & Leadership

  • Demonstrate innovation leadership by driving the adoption of modern cloud practices, automation, and emerging technologies.

  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency through automation, platform engineering, and AIOps capabilities.

  • Provide technical leadership, mentor junior engineers, and influence engineering best practices.

  • Champion a DevOps culture, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence across teams.

Minimum Job Requirements:

Technical Expertise

  • 8-12+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, with a strong focus on cloud technologies (Azure preferred).

  • Deep knowledge of Azure services (compute, networking, storage, security, identity), Azure Landing Zones and enterprise-scale architecture, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep, ARM).

  • Proven experience implementing observability solutions, preferably Dynatrace or similar AIOps platforms.

  • Knowledge of Alibaba Cloud (AliCloud) would be an advantage.

Governance & Regulated Environment

  • Proven experience working in highly regulated industries such as banking, insurance, healthcare, or government.

  • Strong understanding of security frameworks (e.g., NIST, CIS benchmarks) and Cloud governance models and compliance controls.

  • Experience operating within engineering governance frameworks and approval processes.

Architecture Collaboration

  • Experience working with or supporting Enterprise Architecture functions.

  • Ability to interpret and implement enterprise architecture standards, reference architectures, and design principles.

Leadership & Soft Skills

  • Demonstrated innovation leadership and a proven ability to drive transformation initiatives.

  • Strong stakeholder management, collaboration, and communication skills.

  • Ability to operate effectively in complex, matrixed enterprise environments.

Preferred Qualifications

Certifications:

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure DevOps Engineer Expert

  • Relevant security certifications (e.g., CISSP) are an added advantage

Experience with:

  • CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions)

  • Container platforms (Kubernetes, AKS)

  • Platform engineering and self-service cloud capabilities

  • FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization

Build a career with us as we help our customers and the community live Healthier, Longer, Better Lives.

description:
Job Description

Description

Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, investment management and wealth management services. The Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments, and individuals from more than 1,200 offices in 43 countries.

As a market leader, the talent and passion of our people is critical to our success. Together, we share a common set of values rooted in integrity, excellence, and strong team ethic. Morgan Stanley can provide a superior foundation for building a professional career - a place for people to learn, to achieve and grow. A philosophy that balances personal lifestyles, perspectives and needs is an important part of our culture.

Department Profile
The ISG Division is comprised of Equity, Fixed Income, Capital Markets, Investment Banking and Research. Professionals in the Division assess and actively manage risk, trade securities and structure, as well as execute innovative transactions in the fast-paced and constantly changing global markets.

Morgan Stanley’s Institutional Securities Group is looking for a Vice President to join the First Line Central Risk team. The Central Risk team is focused on centralization, standardization, and streamlining of risk management activities across ISG Business Units. The team covers several risk areas including Operational, Third Party, Electronic Trading, Regulatory and Audit, Conduct and Compliance, Client, Product, Financial Crime, Data, Info Security and Cyber, Model and Trader Mandate, and Sustainability.

This role will focus specifically on governance of Operational Risk and Resilience cross-divisional activities.

Role Description
Oversee the risk management practices across the different Institutional Securities businesses to ensure practices are consistent and effectively support business growth initiatives by setting standards, establishing adequate controls and integrity of the Operational Risk systems and processes.

Specifically:

  • Perform ongoing monitoring and reporting of Operational Risk incidents across ISG and ensure timely escalation, including performing issue and incident analysis, lessons learned and remediation recommendations
  • Provide thought leadership and subject matter expertise on lessons learned, risk event analysis, and continuous improvement efforts
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives that enhance risk management practices, governance effectiveness, and organizational resilience
  • Partner with Firmwide teams and ISG Business Control Unit to ensure programmatic requirements across Operational Risk, Resilience and other Firmwide programs impacting ISG, are fit-for-purpose, include our requirements and are implemented consistently across ISG Business Units globally
  • Lead scenario-based exercises and tabletops for the division on a range of risks, including impact of external events (e.g., impacts from changes to the regulatory, political or economic climate)Support senior management decision-making through risk insights, challenge, and strategic advisory activities
  • Monitor consistency and materiality of key risk indicators and determine appropriate actions required, escating as necessary

Critical Success Factors:

  • Strategic thinker with the ability to partner effectively across business units, regions, and lines of defense, including senior management
  • Strong execution and project management skills, with a proven ability to drive outcomes and deliver against critical deadlines
  • Ability to navigate competing priorities and stakeholder expectations in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
  • Strong understanding of the business, operational risk, and regulatory landscape, with the ability to assess implications and emerging developments
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and present complex topics clearly and succinctly to senior audiences
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with strong judgment, professionalism, discretion, and integrity

Qualifications:

  • 5-10 years of related work experience in risk management functions

title: Postdoctoral Research Associate (Fundamental Tumor Immunology) - Radiation Oncology
description:
Location

ST. LOUIS, MO 63110



Position Summary

A Postdoctoral Researcher position is available in the tumor immunology laboratory of Dr. Sana Karam, Professor of Radiation Oncology at WashU Medicine. Situated within the world-renowned WashU Bursky Center for Human Immunology ecosystem, our federally funded research program is fundamentally rooted in basic immunology and cancer biology. We rigorously investigate systemic immunity, the tumor microenvironment (TME), and the mechanistic drivers of resistance to radiation and immunotherapy utilizing advanced pre-clinical models of head/neck and pancreatic cancers.

While our core identity is grounded in fundamental, mechanistic discovery, we possess the rare and privileged ability to directly translate our bench findings into real-time clinical trials. The Karam Lab has a proven, established track record of mentoring postdoctoral fellows into successful independent research careers. We are seeking our next scientific leader.

As our basic science and pre-clinical research programs continue to expand, we are specifically seeking a candidate with rigorous, formal training in fundamental immunology to drive the in vivo and molecular arm of our lab. While the PI remains deeply engaged in the strategic vision and intellectual mentorship of the laboratory, we operate on a model of high-level scientific partnership rather than traditional bench-level micromanagement. You are expected to bring deep mechanistic insight, drive the scientific narrative, and leverage our robust pre-clinical models—complemented by our clinical trial multi-omic data—to build your own high-impact portfolio. This position is designed as a launchpad for an ambitious postdoc intending to build their own independent laboratory.

We are seeking a highly driven, intellectually rigorous, and fiercely curious scientist. The successful candidate must possess a deep hunger for scientific discovery, the ability to think critically and independently, and the ambition to push the boundaries of current oncologic paradigms. Supported by in-house computational biologists and top-tier institutional core facilities, your primary mandate will be high-level hypothesis generation, designing and executing complex mechanistic in vivo models, and driving science forward to high-impact publication.

Job Description

Primary Duties & Responsibilities:

Information on being a postdoc at WashU in St. Louis can be found at https://postdoc.wustl.edu/prospective-postdocs-2/.

Trains under the supervision of a faculty mentor including (but not limited to):

  • Intellectual Leadership: Independently formulate hypotheses regarding systemic immune responses, TME reprogramming, macrophage polarization, and T-cell exhaustion to overcome treatment resistance.
  • Self-Directed Scientific Execution: This laboratory operates on a model of high autonomy and intellectual partnership. The successful candidate will not wait for directives; rather, they are expected to independently identify scientific gaps, propose robust experimental designs, and drive projects forward to completion. You will act as the intellectual engine for our mechanistic immunology studies.
  • Advanced Execution: Design and execute highly complex, fundamental basic science and translational experiments utilizing orthotopic models, targeted radiation platforms (SARRP), and advanced immunological assays.
  • Scientific Communication: Take aggressive ownership of your projects. Analyze data rigorously, draft high-impact manuscripts, and write grant applications (e.g., K99/R00, F32, or foundational grants).
  • Collaborative Mentorship: Engage in high-level scientific discourse with our senior scientists, computational biologists, and graduate students to elevate the overall intellectual rigor of the lab.
  • Elite Mentorship & Team Science: Serve as the day-to-day scientific sounding board and technical mentor for top-tier MSTP and PhD students. You will guide these trainees in advanced immunological techniques and experimental design, effectively acting as a team leader to multiply your own scientific output.

Working Conditions:

This position works in a laboratory environment with potential exposure to biological and chemical hazards. The individual must be physically able to wear protective equipment and to provide standard care to research animals.

Salary Range:

Base pay is commensurate with experience.

Applicant Special Instructions:


Review of applications will begin immediately and continue until the position is filled. Required application materials:


  • A specialized cover letter explicitly detailing your most significant scientific intellectual contribution to date, your career ambitions, and a description of why you thrive in a highly independent environment that values peer-level scientific discourse over day-to-day directive instructions.
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) including a full list of publications.
  • Contact information for three professional references.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all job duties performed by the personnel so classified. Management reserves the right to revise or amend duties at any time.

Ph.D., M.D. Or Equivalent Terminal Or Doctoral Degree.


Certifications/Professional Licenses:

No specific certification/professional license is required for this position.


Work Experience:

No specific work experience is required for this position.


Skills:

Not Applicable

A driver's license is not required for this position.

More About This Job

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Ph.D. or M.D./Ph.D. with deep, formal, and rigorous training in Immunology.
  • A demonstrable track record of operating completely independently. We are seeking a thinker who proposes solutions rather than asking for instructions.
  • A demonstrable track record of productivity and critical thinking, evidenced by first-author publications in peer-reviewed journals.
  • Deep conceptual and technical expertise in advanced immunology: high-parameter flow cytometry, adoptive transfer models, and T-cell/myeloid assays.
  • Extensive experience in executing complex in vivo rodent tumor models.
  • An uncompromising commitment to scientific excellence and the ability to work highly independently.
  • Prior experience in tumor immunology, radiation biology, or radio-immunotherapy.
  • A strong conceptual understanding of bioinformatics (while we have dedicated bioinformaticians, you must be able to "speak their language" and translate data into bench experiments).

title: Knowledge Curator
description:
Are you a detail-oriented documentation expert ready to manage living content, bridge knowledge gaps, and empower AI-driven and human-assisted operations?As our next Knowledge Curator, you will be responsible for maintaining the accuracy, organization, and accessibility of the organization's knowledge assets.

  • Work Setup: PH Remote

  • Start Date: ASAP

  • Schedule: US hours Eastern time

Job Summary

The Knowledge Curator is responsible for maintaining the accuracy, organization, and accessibility of the organization's knowledge assets that support AI-driven and human-assisted operations. This role manages the lifecycle of operational knowledge by coordinating content updates, identifying knowledge gaps, maintaining information architecture, and ensuring documentation remains current, searchable, and aligned with evolving products, policies, and business processes.

What does a day in the life of a Knowledge Curator look like?

  • Review and maintain knowledge assets to ensure documentation accurately reflects current products, services, policies, processes, and operational procedures.

  • Coordinate with subject matter experts and business stakeholders to validate, update, approve, and publish knowledge content in a timely manner.

  • Manage the lifecycle of knowledge assets, including content reviews, revisions, archival activities, and publication schedules.

  • Identify, document, prioritize, and resolve knowledge gaps identified through operational feedback, quality reviews, exception trends, customer interactions, and business changes.

  • Organize, structure, categorize, and tag knowledge content to improve searchability, accessibility, and information retrieval across knowledge management platforms.

  • Review and integrate new or revised documentation while ensuring consistency, accuracy, and adherence to documentation standards.

  • Conduct periodic audits of knowledge repositories to verify content quality, relevance, completeness, and organizational consistency.

  • Monitor changes to products, services, systems, policies, and business processes to ensure knowledge assets remain current and aligned with operational requirements.

  • Maintain documentation standards, governance practices, version control, and knowledge management processes that support organizational consistency and compliance.

  • Develop reports and metrics related to knowledge quality, content health, documentation currency, and knowledge management activities.

  • Collaborate with Operations, Quality, Training, Product, Technology, and other cross-functional teams to support continuous improvement initiatives and operational readiness.

  • Identify opportunities to improve knowledge management processes, content organization, documentation standards, and overall knowledge effectiveness.

  • Adhere to company policies and procedures.

  • Meet or exceed performance targets for related KPIs.

  • Continuously improve knowledge of products, services, and processes by participating in training programs and continuous learning modules.

  • Collaborate with other departments as needed.

  • Maintain a positive, empathetic, and professional attitude toward customers and colleagues at all times.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What are the qualifications of a Knowledge Curator?

  • Minimum of two (2) years of experience in knowledge management, technical writing, documentation, training content development, content management, or a related field.

  • Experience maintaining knowledge bases, documentation repositories, standard operating procedures, help center content, or other operational knowledge assets.

  • Experience coordinating with cross-functional stakeholders to review, validate, and maintain documentation accuracy and completeness.

  • Knowledge of information architecture, content organization, taxonomy, tagging, and documentation best practices.

  • Experience identifying documentation gaps and translating operational feedback into knowledge improvements.

  • Experience utilizing knowledge management platforms, content management systems, documentation tools, or similar technologies is preferred.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with exceptional attention to detail, editing, and documentation quality.

  • Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and recurring review cycles.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate documentation quality, identify trends, and recommend improvements.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment while managing ongoing documentation initiatives.

  • Commitment to documentation excellence, operational accuracy, continuous improvement, and knowledge integrity.

Ninja Perks and Benefits

  • Competitive compensation package with standard allowances

  • Retirement Savings Program with Company Matching to help support your long-term financial goals

  • Life insurance coverage

  • HMO coverage starting on Day 1

  • Free dependent coverage, with one (1) dependent covered upon regularization and a second dependent added after one year of service

  • Paid time off plus birthday leave so you can rest, recharge, and celebrate your special day

  • Opportunities for skills training and personal and professional development to support your continued growth

  • Company-provided IT equipment

title: Wind Technician
description:
Invenergy is North America’s largest privately held developer, owner, and operator of power infrastructure. With 25 years of trusted execution, we deliver reliable, affordable energy through a diverse portfolio that includes natural gas, solar, land-based wind, energy storage, transmission, and domestic manufacturing. Headquartered in Chicago, we develop, own, and operate large scale projects that power communities and support the energy future.

This position will be open for application for at least 3 calendar days from the posting date. This position will remain open for application based on business need, which may be before or after the 3-day posting window.

Job Description

About The Site
The Turkey Track Wind Energy Center is a 169.5 MW wind power generation facility located in Blackwell, TX utilizing GE 1.5 SLE WTG turbine technology.

Position Overview

As a Wind Technician you will be responsible for operating and maintaining the wind turbines at the Turkey Track Wind Energy Center.

Responsibilities

  • Perform routine mechanical and electrical maintenance on GE wind turbine and associated equipment

  • Climb wind turbine towers daily, wearing all required safety equipment, to inspect, maintain, or repair equipment.

  • Understand electrical and mechanical functions of all components of a wind turbine generator and associated equipment

  • Troubleshoot mechanical and electrical faults; repair and/or replace components

  • Maintain company tooling, facilities and equipment and a clean safe work environment

  • Work a 40 hour work week and be subject to scheduled and unscheduled overtime. The work schedule will vary during the peak maintenance periods

Required Skills

  • High school degree or equivalent

  • One (1) year technical experience (mechanical, electrical, etc.) and/or technical education.

  • Must be able to work outdoors in inclement weather, climb ladders without assistance, and work at heights greater than 80 meters (250 feet).

  • Ability to move and manipulate up to 45 kg (100 pounds).

  • Weight must not exceed 120 kg (265 lbs.) excluding equipment/gear worn when performing job related tasks.

  • Valid driver’s license and acceptable driving record.

  • Eligible to work in the United States without the need for employer visa sponsorship now or in the future.

This is a safety sensitive position. Individuals receiving conditional offers of employment will be subject to drug testing and must receive a negative result to begin working for the company.

Base Pay

$29.49 - $49.97 USD Hourly
Bonus: 0% - 10%

In addition to base pay, the total annual compensation package may also include eligibility to participate in our bonus program(s) which are designed to reward individual and company performance. Your recruiter can share more about bonus eligibility for this position during the hiring process.

Invenergy offers a variety of other benefits including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401k, profit sharing, paid time off, etc.

title: Commissioning Supervisor - Process
description:
Remarkable people, trusted by clients to design and advance the world.

Wood is currently recruiting for a Commissioning Supervisor – Process to join the team for an immediate start, supporting commissioning and start-up activities on a major EPCM project for a key client project in Chonburi, Thailand. This role is offered as an initial 12-month contract with the opportunity to continue as an ongoing, longer-term assignment.

Designing the future. Transforming the World.

Wood has a deep history pioneering technical expertise globally for more than 160 years, from the North Sea to the Gulf of Thailand, and is now embarking on an exciting new chapter. Building on 40 years of Engineering excellence in Thailand, Wood invites you to join our dedicated team, to shape the future of the energy industry in Asia Pacific and beyond. Join us in the heart of Chonburi, within a vibrant and fast-growing hub on Thailand’s Eastern Seaboard where you will enjoy being close to major industrial and energy centres with the lifestyle advantages of a coastal location. Perfectly positioned within reach of Bangkok and minutes from the coastline of Pattaya, our office is the ideal blend of career opportunity and coastal lifestyle.

At Wood Thailand you will thrive in a collegiate team culture by partnering with likeminded, agile industry peers to inspire with ingenuity and create new possibilities.

What we can offer

  • Excellent rates, with regular reviews to ensure we are rewarding at the right level in line with the market
  • Ongoing work on interesting projects delivered in partnership to leaders of industry across energy and materials markets
  • Global connections, join an inclusive and diverse international community of inquisitive minds and recognised industry innovators, partnering to create new possibilities
  • Flexible working arrangements balance client, team and individual needs with opportunities for hybrid and remote working
  • Commitment to your Wellbeing, with annual contribution to Health Insurance and free 24/7 access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion; we are an organisation actively committed to diversity and inclusion across our business

#LI-Onsite

Reporting to the Head of Commissioning your immediate focus will be supporting the commissioning and start-up activities on a major EPCM project for a key client. You will bring to life Woods three pillar strategy of Inspired Culture, Delivery Excellence and Profitable Growth on the project. Leading by example, you will consistently display and enforce Wood values and behaviours, and commitment to the highest standards of safe and ethical behaviour, to ensure safe, reliable operations and client satisfaction.

You will thrive on the challenge of balancing technical, team, client, and project leadership in this key site-based role with your focus on relationships and delivery, enabling you to anticipate project needs beyond the immediate scope. You will drive technical excellence and assurance on the Commissiong portion while working in close partnership with other disciplines and the client, to enable robust technical decisions that ultimately add value to the client and project.

In addition, you will:

  • Work with engineers and vendors in the design phases to align handover and commissioning activities including working to troubleshoot, investigate problems and diagnose and repair faults
  • Participate in workshops on design aspects that may assist in pre-commissioning, commissioning and start-up activities
  • Attend P&ID hazard and model reviews
  • Review cause and effect diagrams and spare parts orders
  • Develop and submit commissioning record (closeout) documentation throughout the project in line with documentation plan
  • Prepare of project documentation including pre-commissioning and commissioning procedures
  • Provide input to operational procedures and create and carry out test procedures
  • Be responsible for the supervision of site commissioning activities, including P&ID checking (system check/walk-down/punching), mechanical completion, pre commissioning, cold commissioning (dry/wet), hot commissioning
  • Attend and participate in pre-start up safety review with client and construction contractor (and PMC and licensor as appropriate)
  • Interface with Operations Team in commissioning, start-up and final turnover of the facility/plant

What makes you remarkable?

At Wood, we are committed to equal opportunities and welcome all talented individuals to consider joining our team. So even if you don't match every statement below but feel you have some of the experience, knowledge or skills needed for this role, we encourage you to apply. It will take all of us working together to deliver solutions to the world’s most critical challenges

Expected:

You must hold, or be eligible to obtain, legal working rights in Thailand. If you already have Thai work rights or have a visa or work permit application in progress, we encourage you to apply.

  • Diploma or degree qualified in Chemical Engineering or equivalent combination of qualifications and experience
  • Be a leader of people with several years of supervisory experience, capable of engendering an entrepreneurial spirit of cooperation and energising diverse teams to adopt best practice, driving optimal performance with safety at the heart of everything we do.
  • Appropriate level of commissioning experience in relevant industry sector, typically a minimum of 7 years of engineering experience if degree qualified OR trade discipline qualified with a minimum 10-year relevant practical experience
  • Excellent communication skills (both written and verbal) complemented by your ability to work collaboratively in a multicultural project team
  • Excellent organisational and time management with an ability to maintain an overview of multiple elements of a project, while managing delivery of day-to-day activities
  • Good standard of general computer literacy with knowledge of databases, spreadsheets and engineering programs
  • An ability to work under pressure, when necessary, while still delivering within a challenging and complex environment
  • A “solutions mindset” and able to manage varying tasks with often changing and competing priorities
  • Fully conversant with regards to discipline technical knowledge
  • Proven experience of interpreting discipline documentation and ability to monitor work progress, and report against the plan

Desirable:

What will set you apart will be your previous experience working in a similar role with proven experience across hydrotreater / hydrocracker refinery projects. Thai language (Basic to Intermediate) advantageous but not essential.

It takes a diverse and inclusive community of inquisitive minds to unlock tomorrow’s solutions to the world’s most critical challenges.

If you are a Commissioning Supervisor – Process looking for your next project opportunity in Thailand - apply today!

Shortlisting will commence immediately.

title: SENIOR TECHNOLOGY CONSULTANT
company: YYK WOOD PRODUCTS MANUFACTURING PTE. LTD.
description:
Position: Woodworking Technical Consultant (Solid Wood Furniture, Solid Wood Doors & Windows)Job Responsibilities

1. Technical Solution Coordination: Focus on custom solid wood furniture and doors/windows projects. Based on customer needs, site dimensions, and decoration style, provide reasonable solid wood fabrication, structural, and installation technical solutions, offering precise technical guidance to sales and production workshops.

2. Process Standard Control: Proficient in all processes including solid wood cutting, mortise and tenon joints, splicing, shaping, sanding, painting, and finishing. Develop production process standards for solid wood furniture and doors/windows, and correct process problems during production and installation.

3. Drawing Review and Optimization: Review detailed drawings for solid wood furniture and doors/windows, verifying dimensions, structure, proportions, and opening logic to proactively avoid common solid wood defects such as deformation, cracking, dimensional discrepancies, and installation conflicts.

4. On-site Technical Guidance and After-sales Service: Responsible for on-site measurement and installation guidance, handling difficult problems during solid wood furniture and door/window installation; providing technical solutions for after-sales issues such as cracking, deformation, gaps, and abnormal noises.

5. Quality Acceptance and Control: Responsible for the quality acceptance of semi-finished and finished solid wood furniture, doors, and windows. This includes controlling workmanship details, flatness, sealing, paint finish, and hardware compatibility, and establishing quality acceptance standards.

6. Team Technical Empowerment: Provide solid wood craftsmanship training to production and installation personnel, accumulating practical experience in solid wood fabrication, crack prevention, deformation prevention, moisture and insect prevention, etc., to improve overall product quality.

Job Requirements:

1. Minimum 5 years of independent production, technical, or management experience in solid wood furniture and doors/windows; familiar with the characteristics of various solid wood materials such as logs and multi-layered solid wood.

2. Proficient in solid wood door and window structure, opening methods, sealing techniques, and waterproofing techniques; proficient in core technologies of solid wood furniture, including mortise and tenon joints, design, structural stress, drying, and moisture prevention.

3. Able to read CAD drawings, independently measure, break down orders, optimize processes, and anticipate issues such as solid wood deformation, cracking, and installation compatibility.

4. Familiar with the entire process of solid wood production, sanding, painting, and installation; possesses strong hands-on skills and the ability to independently solve on-site technical problems.

title: Construction Cost Analyst (Semiconductor)
description:
At Cumming Group, you will work on some of the world's most exciting projects in a dynamic environment where your success is measured by the impact you make. We are one of the fastest-growing project and cost management consultancies in the United States, as reflected in our top 10 rankings in ENR. With over 60 offices globally, an extremely diverse project portfolio, and double-digit year-over-year revenue growth, the opportunities to make your mark are limitless!

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Review contractor payment applications and supporting cost documentation for semiconductor construction projects.
  • Validate billed amounts against contract terms, approved Schedule of Values, subcontract values, and actual work completed.
  • Review labor, material, equipment, subcontractor, stored-material, and other supporting cost documentation.
  • Reconcile contractor invoices with approved commitments, subcontractor costs, incurred costs, and completed work.
  • Validate reported percent complete through field verification and coordination with quantity-surveying and construction personnel.
  • Review billing for cleanroom, mechanical, electrical, process piping, structural, architectural, controls, and utility scopes.
  • Identify overbilling, underbilling, duplicate billing, front-loaded values, unsupported charges, and incorrect cost allocations.
  • Review stored-material billing, including invoices, delivery records, ownership documentation, insurance, and onsite or offsite storage verification.
  • Confirm approved change orders are properly incorporated into payment applications and Schedule of Values updates.
  • Review invoices in lump-sum and open-book Guaranteed Maximum Price environments.
  • Validate subcontractor invoices and supporting documentation against contractor billings.
  • Track billing discrepancies and required contractor corrections.
  • Prepare payment-validation reports and payment recommendations.
  • Maintain invoice-review records, reconciliation files, and supporting commercial documentation.

Knowledge & Skills Required:

  • Strong knowledge of construction payment applications, progress billing, and invoice validation.
  • Experience reviewing Schedule of Values, contractor invoices, subcontractor costs, and supporting documentation.
  • Knowledge of lump-sum and open-book Guaranteed Maximum Price billing structures.
  • Ability to reconcile contractor billings with approved commitments, change orders, incurred costs, and completed work.
  • Experience identifying unsupported costs, front-loaded billing, duplicate charges, and incorrect cost allocations.
  • Knowledge of retainage, stored materials, allowances, contingencies, approved change orders, and progress-payment procedures.
  • Understanding of semiconductor construction scopes, including cleanroom, process utility, mechanical, electrical, controls, and tool-installation support.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Experience with construction cost-management, project accounting, or enterprise resource planning systems.

Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Accounting, Finance, Quantity Surveying, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of construction cost control, payment-application review, project accounting, or commercial-management experience.
  • Experience reviewing contractor payment applications on semiconductor fabrication, cleanroom, advanced manufacturing, or other technically complex capital projects.
  • Experience reviewing high-value mechanical, electrical, process utility, and cleanroom invoices.
  • Experience working in both open-book Guaranteed Maximum Price and lump-sum environments.

title: Logistic Employee II
description:
Voor onze gloednieuwe fabriek in Kruiningen zijn wij op zoek naar:

Logistics Employee

(dagdienst)

Als Logistic Employee ben je verantwoordelijk voor het op correcte wijze ontvangen, laden, opslaan, lossen, bij kantelen en transporteren van producten. Ook ben je verantwoordelijk voor ontvangst, lossen, opslag en transporteren van materialen en hulpgoederen. Tevens behoort de administratieve registratie bij ontvangst, handelen en verladen van producten tot de taken. Daarnaast speel je een belangrijke rol in het voorraadbeheer. Je zorgt voor een correcte voorraadregistratie, voert voorraadcontroles uit en signaleert tijdig afwijkingen, zodat de fysieke voorraad overeenkomst met de administratieve voorraad. Je bent uiteraard flexibel inzetbaar. Je rapporteert aan de Supervisor Logistics. De functie wordt in dagdienst uitgevoerd.

Hoe ziet je werk er uit?

  • Als Logistics Employee ben je verantwoordelijk voor het laden, lossen, opslaan en transporteren van het logistieke proces;
  • Je beheert en controleert de voorraden van grondstoffen, verpakkingsmaterialen, hulpgoederen en gereed product en zorgt voor een correcte administratieve verwerking hiervan;
  • Samen met je collega’s, ook van andere afdelingen, streef je naar optimale resultaten;
  • Je ziet waar zaken beter kunnen en neemt hiertoe dan ook initiatief;
  • Je werkt volgens de vastgestelde procedures en richtlijnen en je zorgt dat de (voedsel) veiligheid gewaarborgd blijft;
  • Je voert de administratieve taken die bij ontvangst, handelen en verladen van producten horen netjes uit;
  • Je verricht schoonmaakwerkzaamheden en je zorgt ervoor dat jouw afdeling er altijd netjes bij ligt.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je bent enthousiast en je bent niet vies van hard werken;
  • Je hebt een diploma op minimaal MBO-2 niveau of bent bereid deze te gaan halen;
  • Afgerond heftruckcertificaat;
  • Opleiding en ervaring zijn belangrijk, maar we vinden je motivatie en inzet nóg belangrijker.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een groeiende organisatie waar veel geïnvesteerd wordt in nieuwe technieken;
  • Veel mogelijkheden om door te groeien en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen;
  • Een prima pakket arbeidsvoorwaarden met naast je basissalaris o.a.: 8,33% vakantietoeslag, 4% einde boekjaar uitkering, de pensioen premie betaald door de werkgever en 34 vakantiedagen;

description:
Job Title: Operation SpecialistJob Category: Project and Program ManagementTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: TS/SCIEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%Type of Travel: Continental US* * *

The Opportunity:

Join a team dedicated to advancing national security through innovative irregular warfare and operations expertise. CACI is hiring Operations Specialists to join an upcoming program that will deliver mission-critical advisory, training, and operational support services that help mission partners stay ahead of rapidly evolving global threats. Working across geographic and functional combatant commands, these professionals play a vital role in developing, integrating, and sustaining mission-ready task forces that enhance joint force effectiveness and operational success.

Operations Specialists are responsible for overseeing the day-to-day execution of program operations, ensuring mission objectives are achieved through effective planning, resource management, process optimization, and operational oversight. Position serves as a key member of the program leadership team, coordinating cross-functional activities, managing operational performance, and implementing standardized processes that support efficient and compliant execution of Department of Defense (DoD) and Combatant Command (COCOM) missions. Successful Operations Specialists will drive operational excellence by improving workflows, monitoring program performance, mitigating risks, and ensuring quality service delivery while maintaining alignment with customer requirements and organizational objectives.

This is an opportunity to contribute to high-impact missions, collaborate with experienced professionals, and support strategic operations that strengthen our nation's defense capabilities around the world. Candidates who thrive in dynamic environments, embrace complex challenges, and are committed to mission excellence will find meaningful opportunities for growth and impact within CACI and on this team.

*Positions are contingent upon contract award.

Responsibilities:

  • Oversee daily program operations to ensure successful execution of mission requirements, contract objectives, and customer priorities

  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve operational processes, workflows, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to enhance efficiency, consistency, and quality

  • Coordinate personnel, resources, schedules, and operational activities across multiple functional teams to support mission success

  • Monitor program performance metrics, analyze operational data, and identify opportunities to improve productivity, reduce risk, and optimize resource utilization.

  • Conduct operational assessments and identify process improvements that increase efficiency and support continuous program growth

  • Ensure compliance with contractual requirements, organizational policies, and applicable government regulations

  • Lead quality assurance initiatives, conduct audits and reviews to verify adherence to established standards and operational procedures

  • Identify operational risks and develop mitigation strategies to minimize mission impacts and improve program resilience

  • Collaborate with program leadership, government customers, subcontractors, and support organizations to resolve operational issues and improve service delivery

Grade 130

Summary: The Anesthesia Technician functions as an assistant to members of the anesthesia staff (Anesthesiologists and CRNA's) to facilitate and support delivery of perioperative care to the patient by the Anesthesia Team. The Anesthesia Technician will also assure the practice of the Patient and Family Centered Care Model in an environment that exemplifies best practice.
Does this position require Patient Care? Yes
Essential Functions: Collaborates in the perioperative anesthesia care of patients to ensure safety and efficiency of care as observed by the members of the anesthesia team, and reports to the Nurse Manager of the Operating Room and the Chief of Anesthesia.
-Participates in the transfer of patients from stretcher/bed.
-Attaches vital signs and related monitoring devices to the patient.
-Collaborates with the Surgical Team in positioning of patients for special procedures (spinal, epidural, sitting, prone).
-Participates in the intubation procedure under the direction supervision of the anesthetist/anesthesiologist by preparing and holding equipment and applying cricoid pressure to the trachea.
-Collaborates in the safe, efficient transfer of the patient from the operating room to the PACU by having transfer oxygen and ambu bag available immediately post operatively.
-Performs related duties in a prompt and courteous manner, such as transporting blood samples to respiratory for blood gases.
Maintains appropriate supply of anesthesia equipment and pharmaceutical supplies in all locations where anesthesia and related procedures are administered in the hospital to facilitate prompt anesthesia care for the patient. These activities are monitored by the anesthesia staff and reported to the Nurse Manager of the Operating Room and the Chief of Anesthesia.
-Coordinates requests from the anesthesia team by collecting items needed during each surgical procedure.
-Maintains par levels of gas tanks for the anesthesia units (machines).
-Maintains anesthesia equipment/monitoring units in working condition communicating with the biomedical department and/or equipment service representatives to insure availability of equipment.
-Executes equipment repairs within 24 hours to ensure patient safety and continuance of planned schedule of surgical procedures.
-Monitors a log of daily anesthesia equipment safety checks, performed by anesthesia technician, and documented appropriately, to comply with safety requirements established by the hospital, accreditation requisites and regulatory agencies.
-Assists the Nurse Manager by completing purchase requisitions for needed items when par levels are affected.
Maintains all equipment and instrumentation in clean organized condition in accordance to the hospital infection management policy.
-Maintains cleanliness of all anesthesia carts and machines.
-Maintains appropriately, special instruments and equipment, i.e. fiberoptic bronchoscope, endtidal, CO2 monitors, humidifiers, etc.
-Operates STERIS machine and sterilizers according to operational standards.
-Participates in the special cleaning and/or removal and terminal sterilization of equipment exposed to diagnosed contagious diseases. Participates in quality assurance activities for the operating room and the Department of Anesthesia upon request.
-Collects data as required by the quality assurance criteria determined by the Chief of Anesthesia and/or Nurse Manager.
